context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend API contract quirks discovered: POST /api/hr/employees requires 'full_name' (NOT 'name'); response returns employee_id at top level (not nested). POST /api/hr/leave/apply returns {leave_id, days}. GET /api/hr/leave/pending returns {pending_leaves, count}. GET /api/hr/leave/my returns {leaves, balance}. POST /api/hr/payroll/generate returns {records: [...]} (list, not single). Employee expense endpoints are under /api/hr/expense/*. Frontend: AttendancePayroll uses custom <button> tabs (not role=tab); use text selector 'Payroll / पेरोल'. Payroll sidebar menu needs expansion click before 'Attendance & Payroll'.
